debt.text: Riley pledges never to cut Social Security or Medicare and to expand Medicare benefits.
debt.quote: Josh will never cut a penny from Social Security or Medicare.

housing.text: Riley wants to lower housing costs by surging new construction and barring Wall Street investors from buying homes.
housing.quote: Driving down the cost of housing by surging construction and banning Wall Street investors from buying up homes

schools.text: Riley opposes efforts to dismantle the Department of Education and strip funding from local public schools.
schools.quote: Blocking extreme efforts to dismantle the Department of Education and strip funding from our local schools

immigration.text: Riley calls the southern border a disaster and wants more border agents to secure it, while also saying he supports legal immigration.
immigration.quote: The Southern Border is an absolute disaster, and Joe Biden, Marc Molinaro, and Washington politicians from both parties have failed us

guns.text: Riley supports universal background checks to close loopholes and keep guns from dangerous individuals.
guns.quote: Fighting for universal background checks to close dangerous loopholes and keep weapons out of the hands of individuals who pose a danger

abortion.text: Riley says abortion is a woman's decision and pledges to protect the right to choose in Congress.
abortion.quote: I've fought for a woman's right to choose, and I'll do the same in Congress.

health.text: Riley calls healthcare a civil right and supports expanding Medicare benefits and drug-price negotiation.
health.quote: Josh believes that healthcare should be a civil right in America, not something that bankrupts so many American families.

energy.text: Riley supports protecting the EPA's authority to regulate greenhouse gases and combat climate change.
energy.quote: Protecting the EPA's ability to regulate greenhouse gases and combat climate change

voting.text: Riley wants to restore the Voting Rights Act and ensure every voter can be heard.
voting.quote: restore the Voting Rights Act and guarantee that every voter can have their voice heard
